damaged.name: crc_flip
damaged.why: one bit flipped in page 2: CRC fails, the page and the records it held are lost

damaged.name: mac_flip_recrc
damaged.why: ciphertext altered and the CRC recomputed: only the CMAC catches it

damaged.name: torn_write
damaged.why: power lost while programming the last page: its tail reads erased; the segment is not closed

damaged.name: uncorrectable_ecc
damaged.why: the W25N reports an uncorrectable ECC error on page 3: marked, skipped, reported

damaged.name: bad_block_skip
damaged.why: block 3 (4 pages per block here) is bad and holds garbage; the segment continues in block 4

damaged.name: erased_and_other_order
damaged.why: pages given out of physical order with erased pages in between: order comes from the header
